title: .alc reader and writer with line-located errors
description:
## Intent
Read and write `.alc` files.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/alc.rs`: `write(&WarpMap, audio: &Path, name: &str) -> Vec<u8>` (gzip XML, the minimal document from §Formats, file reference relative to where the `.alc` will sit plus the absolute fallback) and `read(bytes, file_name) -> Result<AlcClip, SidecarError>` (`AlcClip` = WarpMap + name + referenced audio path).
- Strict reading: markers increasing in both axes, at least two when warped, known root/version attributes; errors carry the decompressed XML line and element path (`WarpMarkers/WarpMarker[4]`).
- Makes the `.alc` scenarios of `features/daw/sidecar_formats.feature` green.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw` (all `.alc` scenarios green). Manual: open one written `.alc` in the DAW from its browser; it plays on the grid (record the DAW version in a comment).

Commit: `feat(<this id>): read and write .alc clip files`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
